text:
Megan Wang: Quick heads up — I've submitted a formal request for a 6-month unpaid sabbatical starting 2026-05-01. @Priya Singh @Julian Park can we coordinate benefits continuation, COBRA timing, and an asset/SSO handoff? Thanks! :wave:

Priya Singh: Congrats, Megan! :tada: High-level: we usually offer up to 60 days of employer-paid continuation for approved sabbaticals, then COBRA is available. We'll need a signed LOA. Can you confirm your last payroll day (so benefits/payroll can calculate)?

Megan Wang: Confirming last payroll day = 2026-04-30. Return-to-work target = 2026-11-01. This is unpaid leave; please advise on PTO payout and any pro-rated bonus.

Priya Singh: Got it. We'll include accrued PTO payout on final paycheck and check bonus proration rules. 401(k) contributions stop during unpaid leave; you'd re-enroll on return. I'll DM the LOA and benefits summary link.

hr-bot: Please review and upload the Leave of Absence form within 5 business days: https://redwoodhr.company/loa — HR will process continuation once we have the signed form.

Julian Park: I'll run the operational handoff. Megan, can you drop a short runbook + list of critical PRs and owners? Also let's arrange overlap with a shadow on pager duty for the first two weeks.

Megan Wang: Added runbook & checklist here: https://redwooddocs/internal/mw-sabbatical-handoff — includes streaming-inference rollout state, blocked items, and owner tags. Will tag @eng-sre for shadowing.

it-ops: Asset return/process notes: we'll open a ticket on your last day to schedule device drop-off or provide a prepaid shipping label. Please return laptop + power adapters. Note SSO/org access will be suspended 2026-04-30 23:59 PT. If you need limited ongoing access, file an "Admin-approved limited access" request and include justification.

Priya Singh: Benefits timeline (prelim): employer-paid continuation through 2026-06-29 (60 days). COBRA election window begins 2026-06-30 (you have 60 days to elect). If you'd like to request extended employer continuation beyond 60 days, that's exceptional and needs manager + finance signoff — let me know and I'll kick off approvals.

Megan Wang: Appreciate that. One more ask: can I keep read-only Slack access during the sabbatical? I might check in for a couple high-priority launches.

Julian Park: Fine by me to keep Slack read-only access for 6 months. We'll remove on-call/alert entitlements and set expectation that you won't be paged. Priya — please mark in HR system.

Priya Singh: Noted. We'll tag account as "sabbatical - read-only" and adjust entitlements accordingly. Exit/LOA checklist: sign LOA, return assets, final payroll calc, benefits continuation processed, COBRA notice after employer continuation ends. We'll also schedule a quick check-in for re-onboarding logistics 30 days before your return.

Megan Wang: Perfect. I'll sign the LOA today and confirm shipment details for the laptop. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
